title: Condensed exchange under an isomorphism of coefficient rings
statement: Let R and S be commutative condensed ring objects [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], let e:R ≅ S be a ring-object isomorphism, and let sq be any chosen Cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Assume the actual ambient exchange [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange] over S is an isomorphism on every constant-model constructible finite-Tor complex on the upper-right scheme Z [sk-def-sfb-constructible; det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude]. Then the actual ambient exchange over R is an isomorphism on every such complex over R on Z. All functors act on ordinary unbounded derived categories of internal modules [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. No properness, finite-type or coefficient-admissibility assumption is needed.

source.place: Proof (2), coefficient transport for proper base change on the generators; normalized scalar/geometric rectangle made explicit.

proof.text: Scalar extension along the coefficient isomorphism is an equivalence. Its derived functor agrees with exact restriction of scalars along the inverse coefficient map. The coefficient-isomorphism constructibility theorem and repleteness therefore put the scalar extension of each constant-model constructible finite-Tor object in the same subcategory over S.

Choose the normalized internal scalar-pullback comparisons, which are uniquely specified by normalization. Both derived scalar functors are equivalences, so the right mates of these comparisons are isomorphisms by the mate-equivalence theorem.

The normalized scalar/geometric rectangle, with the actual condensed-ambient exchange identification, expresses the image under scalar extension of the exchange over R in terms of exchange over S and the invertible pullback comparisons and their mates. The hypothesis makes exchange over S invertible at the transported object. Scalar extension, an equivalence, reflects isomorphisms and gives the conclusion.

theorem condensedAmbientExchange_coefficientIso
    {R S : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}}
    [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R] [MonObj S] [IsCommMonObj S]
    (e : Mon.mk R ≅ Mon.mk S)
    {A Z Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} {a : A ⟶ Z} {q' : A ⟶ Y'}
    {q : Z ⟶ Y} {v : Y' ⟶ Y} (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare a q' q v)
    (h : ∀ C : ConstantModelConstructibleFiniteTor S Z,
      IsIso ((condensedAmbientExchange S sq).app C.obj))
    (K : ConstantModelConstructibleFiniteTor R Z) :
    IsIso ((condensedAmbientExchange R sq).app K.obj)
